whatis.intro: A par level is the full mark for one line: the stock level each order brings it back up to. The order is the gap between today's count and that mark. At 120 cases a day, a 7 day cycle and 2 buffer days, the mark is 1,080 cases.

cards.title: A full cycle plus a reserve
cards.body: The whole gap between two deliveries, plus your reserve. That is why par should look high on delivery day: it has to last until the next truck.
cards.alt: Plus sign, for the gap between two deliveries

cards.title: Busy days look like average ones
cards.body: Which days run busy. Par prices every day at the average, so a short cycle that holds your heaviest days draws on the 2 buffer days.
cards.alt: Minus sign, for the busy days an average hides

cards.title: Peak cash, not average cash
cards.body: The $23,760 at par is the most the line holds, on delivery day. Across the cycle the floor averages well below it, and that average is what carrying costs run on.
cards.alt: Light bulb, for the peak cash a line holds at par

who.h2: Who uses a par level calculator
who.intro: Whoever restocks a distributor's warehouse on a regular supplier delivery cycle uses it to set par, one line at a time. Anyone who sizes the next top up order, or answers for the cash it ties up, should run it.

look.h2: When a par level comes out wrong
look.intro: Par is one multiplication. The count, the days and the way your supplier ships are where a top up goes wrong.

steps.title: A count of what can sell
steps.body: Leave damaged and short dated cases out of the 340 on hand. Count them in and the 740 case top up comes in short.

steps.title: Days on the same footing
steps.body: If 120 cases a day is per shipping day, count the cycle in shipping days too. Mix shipping days with calendar days and par reads high.

steps.title: How your supplier ships
steps.body: Par settles to whole cases, but a supplier who sells by the layer or the pallet rounds the order again. Check that the rounding does not leave the line over par every cycle.

vos.h2: Where VOS fits around a par level
vos.h3: Orders arrive line by line, on your own SKUs
vos.body: VOS does not set par levels, count your stock or buy from your suppliers. Par is set line by line, and that is how orders reach you. Each account orders by voice in the VOS app, from a guide tied to your SKUs.
